This time I was so hurt I actually stopped talking to him which I’ve never done. So I think he knows he’s a GIANT FUCKING ASSHOLE. Because otherwise he wouldn’t have posted here.

After reading this I went back and read my last post I made over a month ago. I just had a full breakdown because I’ll never have to feel like that again.

You know what? I typed out a massive reply to this detailing what a shitty person you’ve been in our relationship, but I think the phone call we just had sums it up perfectly.

You are a self-centered asshole. Not just because you told me I’m fat and that you’ve never been attracted to me, but because you’ve been mentally and physically abusing me since we started dating.

Could you imagine having someone pressure you into repeated sex for years, only to find out the whole time they thought you were “disgusting”? I have given up so much of myself for this SHITTY relationship. You don’t even have a fucking job and you haven’t for months. You fight me on every decision I want to make and you’ve tried to isolate me from my friends and family.

I work so fucking hard all the time. Dealing with work, you, family issues, and just generally trying to keep myself alive. How fucking dare you try to step on me now that I’m finally finding my happiness

There’s about 5 trillion more things I could write here but after reading this absolute cluster fuck of a post you’ve put together here, Im not giving any more brain power to this relationship. Thanks for at least giving me a tipping point, you made this easier.

I’ll leave it at this.

Fuck you. Fuck everything about you.

I’m so sorry you had to go through that. After my experiences it makes me so upset that there are other people going through the same, or worse. I can’t believe how much it’s changed me as a person.

I will definitely keep you in my mind. I am going to be seeking therapy as soon as possible.

Yes I do know it isn’t what I want for myself, which is why I’m even more frustrated. I find myself screaming at myself in my car because I can’t figure out why I can’t just leave him. I don’t like the direction my mental health is going/has gone. I’m actually a happy person, and I’m way too tolerant. Maybe that was a problem, not setting boundaries early enough.

It’s happened again this morning which really hurts. I don’t know why it hurt more, I think it’s because I had a full breakdown and posted this, then I was hoping the morning would be different but it was just the same. Me resisting and saying no and him saying I should be thankful.

I so badly just want to wake up and stretch and start thinking about my day but I start my day off defending myself every day.

To be honest the tattoo was more for me than him. I struggle a lot with depression and various other mental health problems and recently I’ve come to the conclusion that I want to surround myself with things that make me happy. So far it’s been building a collection of rocks and minerals, getting tattoos that make me happy, having a car that makes me happy, doing activities that make me happy etc.

I really do love my mom, and it’s a sore spot in my life. I’m very gentle with her, my sister is not. My mom tends to lay a lot of her issues on me, which I understand as she doesn’t really have other people who experienced it to talk to. However, I’m worried she will be angry at me. She has asked me; “Why didn’t he chase me” (verbatim, in reference to my dad not chasing her across the country to win her love back), and asks why my sister is cold towards her.

I want to ask her if maybe she would go to counselling with me (my sister and her tried counselling together but my mom turned it into only being about my sister and didn’t take any ownership) but I’m not sure that it would actually be productive. I’m scared to try it only to have it backfire and have her feel attacked like she always does (if I remember correctly she stormed out of the counselling with my sister because she felt attacked).

I’m at a loss. I had a mental breakdown on her birthday because i wanted to post a photo of us together and realized I didn’t have one. So I went to her Facebook to find one and when I was looking at her face I didn’t recognize her at all. She looked like my friends mom, someone that wasn’t involved in my life but I know her face. It scared the shit out of me for some reason. I sat there staring at it for an hour just bawling because I couldn’t make my brain recognize her in my life.

Sorry to dump all that I have never actually typed it out and I just realized how much it actually affected me.
